permit.permittypedesc: PLACE EQUIPMENT OTHER THAN CRANE OR SHOV
permit.specificstipulations: FS USE FLAGGERS TO ASSIST PEDESTRIANS DURING WORK HOURS. NO IMPACT TO INTERSECTION CROSSWALK. MUST COORDINATE WITH ANY ONGOING CONSTRUCTION PRIOR TO MOBILIZING.

stipulations.stipulationfulltext: FLAG PERSON(S) MUST BE PROVIDED TO STOP PEDESTRIAN AND/OR VEHICLE TRAFFIC WHILE LIFTING MATERIALS OVERHEAD AND/OR WHEN CROSSING THE SIDEWALK IN CONJUNCTION WITH CROSSING SIDEWALK PERMITS.
MAINTAIN A MINIMUM 8 FOOT CLEAR PEDESTRIAN WALKWAY ON SIDEWALK.

FULL WIDTH OF THE SIDEWALK SHALL BE OPENED TO PEDESTRIANS WHEN THE SITE IS UNATTENDED, EXCEPT DURING CONCRETE CURING, WHEN THAT PORTION OF THE SIDEWALK MAY REMAIN CLOSED, PROVIDED THE PERMITTEE COMPLIES WITH ALL OTHER STIPULATIONS ON THIS PERMIT. THIS CONCRETE CURING EXCEPTION DOES NOT APPLY IF STIPULATION 014 IS ALSO APPLIED TO THIS PERMIT.

ALL TEMPORARY TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICES, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO SIGNS, CHANNELIZING DEVICES, FENCING AND MARKINGS SHALL BE PROVIDED, INSTALLED, MAINTAINED AND REMOVED BY THE PERMITTEE IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE MOST RECENT VERSION OF PART 6 OF THE MANUAL ON UNIFORM TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICES FOR STREETS AND HIGHWAYS (MUTCD). OBTAIN THE MUTCD AT HTTP://MUTCD.FHWA.DOT.GOV .
OCCUPY 8 FOOT WIDTH OF ROADWAY ADJACENT  TO EAST CURBLINE

DO NOT PLACE MATERIALS, TRAILERS, CRANES, DEBRIS CONTAINERS, OR OTHER EQUIPMENT IN FRONT OF DRIVEWAYS, BUS STOPS, WITHIN FIFTEEN FEET OF A FIRE HYDRANT, IN AUTHORIZED PARKING ZONES OR IN ANY WAY WHICH BLOCKS ACCESS TO NYC DEP WATER TESTING BOXES. IF WORK MUST OCCUR DIRECTLY IN THESE AREAS, ANY OBSTRUCTION MAY ONLY BE DURING THE STIPULATED WORKING HOURS, AND NOT WHEN SITE IS UNATTENDED. ADDITIONAL COORDINATION MAY BE REQUIRED.
WORK SATURDAY 8AM - 6PM AND SUNDAY 9AM - 6PM. SECTION 24-224 ADMINISTRATIVE CODE VARIANCE GRANTED FOR HOURS AND DAYS STIPULATED HEREIN.

THIS PERMIT ACTIVITY MAY NOT START UNTIL THE PERMITTEE COORDINATES ALL WORK WITH ANY ONGOING CONSTRUCTION AND/OR WITH THE PROJECT/RESIDENT ENGINEER FOR ANY ONGOING CAPITAL PROJECTS OCCURRING WITHIN AND/OR ADJACENT TO THE STREET SEGMENT/INTERSECTION.

LOADING AND UNLOADING, STANDING OR PARKING IN A LANE ADJACENT TO THE WORK ZONE IN THE ROADWAY, AND PARKING OF NON-COMMERCIAL VEHICLES ON THE STREET (ROADWAY AND/OR SIDEWALK) WITHIN WORK ZONES IS PROHIBITED UNLESS OTHERWISE STIPULATED ON THE PERMIT. THIS APPLIES TO PERMITTEES AND ALL THEIR SUBCONTRACTORS.
A WAIVER IS GRANTED TO ALLOW WORK TO OCCUR DURING THE HOLIDAY CONSTRUCTION EMBARGO (IN EFFECT ANNUALLY FROM NOVEMBER 15TH THROUGH JANUARY 2ND THE FOLLOWING YEAR), AS STIPULATED BY THE OCMC OFFICE.

IF WORK IMPACTS A SHARED VEHICLE AND BICYCLE LANE, THE PERMITTEE MUST POST THE SIGN ASSEMBLY SC-151 AND SC-152 AT THE WORK ZONE AND THE SIGN ASSEMBLY SC-145 AND SC-152. IF THE 50 FEET FALLS WITHIN THE INTERSECTION, IT SHOULD BE INSTALLED ON THE APPROACH TO THE INTERSECTION AND ON THE SIDEWALK AT A LOCATION BETWEEN THE CROSSWALK AND STOP BAR. FOR SIGN ASSEMBLY INFORMATION SEE BIKE MPT DESIGN GUIDELINES. PERMITTEE MUST COMPLY WITH THE BIKE MPT DESIGN GUIDELINES, WHICH ARE AVAILABLE AT https://www1.nyc.gov/html/dot/downloads/pdf/bike-mpt-guidelines.pdf

A BIKE SHARE STATION IS/WILL BE LOCATED ON THIS STREET. PERMITTEE SHALL NOT MOVE, DAMAGE OR DISRUPT THE OPERATION OF THE STATION. IF WORK IMPACTS THE STATION, THE PERMITTEE MUST CONTACT NYC BIKE SHARE AT 855-245-3311 FOR THEIR REQUIREMENTS PRIOR TO WORK. THE PERMITTEE MAY BE REQUIRED TO PAY STATION DEACTIVATION AND/OR REMOVAL CHARGES.

If metered parking regulations are within your project area, either on the sidewalk or in the roadway, DOT Parking Unit must be notified before work begins to determine if meters need to be removed, relocated and to identify metered space loss. The contractor shall not relocate, remove, enclose, or attempt to barricade the meters. DOT Parking Unit must be notified upon work completion to restore metered parking. Please complete the DOT Parking Meter Construction Impact Webform to initiate the process: https://nyc.gov/meterconstruction. For more information call (212) 839-3230.

BY SUBMITTING THIS APPLICATION AND/OR RENEWAL REQUEST, THE PERMITTEE CERTIFIES ITS COMPLIANCE WITH ALL APPLICABLE CITYWIDE CONSTRUCTION NOISE MITIGATION REQUIREMENTS INCLUDING, BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF A COMPLIANT NOISE MITIGATION OR ALTERNATIVE NOISE MITIGATION PLAN. UPON COMPLETION, PLEASE UPLOAD/FILE YOUR PLANS ONTO THE DEPARTMENT OF ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION WEBSITE. HERE IS THE LINK FOR FURTHER DETAILS AND TO UPLOAD THE FORMS: https://www1.nyc.gov/site/dep/environment/construction-noise-mitigation.page

NO WORK SHALL BE PERFORMED WITHIN A BLOCK FRONTING A SCHOOL, INCLUDING INTERSECTIONS, FOR ONE HOUR PRIOR TO SCHOOL START TIME THROUGH ONE HOUR AFTER END OF SCHOOL TIME. THE PERMITTEE MUST NOTIFY THE SCHOOL PRINCIPAL IN WRITING 48 HOURS PRIOR TO BEGINNING ANY WORK. THIS STIPULATION VOIDS ANY/ ALL OTHER CONFLICTING STIPULATIONS ON THIS PERMIT UNLESS ACCOMPANIED WITH THE VARIANCE STIPULATION VAR001.

PERMITTEE SHALL NOT REMOVE, DAMAGE OR OBSTRUCT ACCESS TO ANY NYC DOT-OWNED BIKE RACKS, BENCHES, LEANING BARS, BLOCKS, PLANTERS, OR WALKNYC WAYFINDING SIGNS ON THE SIDEWALK OR ROADWAY, INCLUDING SURROUNDING SIDEWALK, STREET, SUBSURFACE FOUNDATIONS, OR SUBSURFACE ELECTRICAL CONDUIT. PERMITTEE MUST ALWAYS PROVIDE 3 FT ACCESS TO ASSET. PERMITTEE MUST CONTACT NYC DOT VIA EMAIL AT STREETFURNITUREUNIT@DOT.NYC.GOV TO COORDINATE REMOVALS A MINIMUM TWO (2) WEEKS PRIOR TO THE START OF WORK. PERMITTEE IS RESPONSIBLE FOR REPLACEMENT OF DAMAGED STREET FURNITURE ELEMENTS.

CONTRACTORS WHO AT ANY TIME DURING THEIR PERMITTED WORK ENCOUNTER TRAFFIC SURVEILLANCE CAMERAS, DETECTION EQUIP OR ANY TYPE OF COMMUNICATION EQUIPMENT (WIRELESS OR HARD-WIRED) ON ANY NYCDOT FACILITY, THAT IS NOT INCLUDED ON THE DESIGN/BUILD DWGS, SHALL IMMEDIATELY NOTIFY NYCDOT TRAFFIC MANAGEMENT AT TMCDOT@DOT.NYC.GOV & 718-433-3390/40 AND AWAIT DIRECTION PRIOR TO CONTINUING WORK
